activationMechanics.predicate: Activation predicate (frozen): a typed ICampaignApplicationReceiptPort installed once on CampaignHostRegistry by server.js at boot; the binder composes application from it, each entry derives a graph-local CampaignLaunchView from it, and both HTTP doors key on its presence while building their own graph-bound view; no other switch exists.
activationMechanics.installPoint: CampaignHostRegistry, the one object all three doors already share across the tsx socket graph and the Next API graph (the Symbol.for('mekstation.multiplayer.campaignHostRegistry') slot): the binder defaults to it, the launch-authority route reads it, mission create uses it.
activationMechanics.installTime: server.js loadMultiplayerRuntime, first called inside app.prepare().then before createServer and server.listen (verified at server.js 520-541 and 882).
activationMechanics.beforeP2CG1H: The registry port is null in every process: application is null, the three socket sites use the legacy session gate, the HTTP preflight uses the legacy cursor gate (head-only for session-less bodies), mission create uses the old create, and transport hardening is unreachable because receipt mode never latches.
activationMechanics.atP2CG1H: One merge installs the port. Offers flow, bound clients latch receipt mode and ACK through the P2CF2 consumer, P2CA writes rows, every door reads P2CB, and numeric ACKs are refused campaign-application-receipt-required. There is no interval in which receipts flow while a door still reads legacy credit (C1 closed by construction).
activationMechanics.ordering: C before K: P2CG1E keeps lastSeq on bound joins before P2CG1G2 binds the creators, so binding is byte-identical on the wire against the legacy binder.
activationMechanics.legacyDeletion: Its own post-activation units P2CG1I1 (HTTP and client), P2CG1I2 (test migration) and P2CG1I3 (server). After P2CG1H the legacy credit is unreachable, so deletion changes no production readiness.
activationMechanics.rollback: Before P2CG1I1, revert the server.js install line; the predicate is the port's presence, not persisted state, and the N4 backfill is idempotent.
activationMechanics.tests: Tests install the port on a reset registry (_resetCampaignHostRegistry); the binder applicationReceipts dependency stays for test composition. No boolean switch exists.

productionSafety.rule: No unit disables working legacy before activation, and every intermediate main keeps production co-op working.
